source.title: Expression of Interest for 2028 WCA Continental Championships & 2029 WCA World Championship
source.content:
Dear WCA Community,

The WCA Major Championship Team (WMCT) is pleased to be opening an Expression of Interest (EoI) period for the 2028 Continental Championships and 2029 World Championship, following the procedures defined in[ Motion 22.2025.1 - Major Championship Selection](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/22.2025.1%2520-%2520Major%2520Championship%2520Selection.pdf). We would like to receive EoIs for the following regions for 2028 Continental Championships:

- Africa
- Asia
- Europe
- North America
- Oceania
- South America

This EoI period will serve as an opportunity to discuss possibilities about future Continental and World Championships, and will allow the WMCT to have more information about the interest for these Championships. Organizations that intend to lodge a formal bid are strongly recommended to submit an EoI.

Organizing a WCA Championship of this scale takes a significant amount of time and effort, spanning pre-event preparation, the championship itself, and post-event tasks. It is imperative that the Championship organizers, as well as a substantial portion of the WCA Delegates in your country are committed to the preparation and the execution of this event. It is recommended to privately request the WMCT’s Guide for Major Championship Organizers before submitting an EoI.

To register your interest please send an email to championships@worldcubeassociation.org before December 20th, 2026, 23:59 UTC with the subject line of “EoI from <Location/Team> to bid for <Region> Championship <Year>”. This email should include at least:
	
- The Regional Organization or the registered entity that would be sending the application
- Outline of the main organizing team, listing roles and experience
- Location(s) of the championship
- Possible venue(s)

Please note that applications must be made by a [WCA Regional Organization](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/organizations) or by a registered entity if the host city is located in a region without a RO. Please include as much information as possible about the potential championship bid. The WMCT will open the formal bidding process in early 2027.

translation.title: 2028 年洲际锦标赛及 2029 年世锦赛承办意向征集
translation.content:
亲爱的 WCA 社区成员：

WCA 大型锦标赛组（WMCT）现依照[《22.2025.1 号决议——大型锦标赛遴选》](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/22.2025.1%2520-%2520Major%2520Championship%2520Selection.pdf)规定的程序，征集 2028 年洲际锦标赛及 2029 年世界锦标赛的承办意向（EoI）。2028 年洲际锦标赛承办意向征集覆盖以下地区：

- 非洲
- 亚洲
- 欧洲
- 北美洲
- 大洋洲
- 南美洲

此次意向征集旨在探讨未来洲际锦标赛及世界锦标赛的举办方案，让 WMCT 更充分地了解各方的承办意愿。强烈建议有意正式申办的组织提交承办意向。

举办这一规模的 WCA 锦标赛需要投入大量时间和精力，工作涵盖赛前筹备、比赛举办以及赛后事务。赛事主办方及所在国家相当一部分 WCA 代表都必须愿意投入赛事的筹备和执行。建议在提交承办意向前，私下向 WMCT 索取《大型锦标赛主办方指南》。

如有承办意向，请在 2026 年 12 月 20 日 23:59（UTC）之前发送邮件至 championships@worldcubeassociation.org，邮件主题为“EoI from <Location/Team> to bid for <Region> Championship <Year>”（将占位内容替换为地点或团队、地区和年份）。邮件至少应包括：

- 将提交申请的地区性组织或已注册实体
- 核心主办团队简介，列明成员分工和经验
- 拟举办锦标赛的地点
- 可选场馆

请注意，申请必须由 [WCA 地区性组织](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/organizations)提交；若主办城市所在地区没有地区性组织（RO），则须由已注册实体提交。请尽可能详细地介绍拟申办赛事的情况。WMCT 将于 2027 年初启动正式申办程序。
